## TRA Timeline

#### BCA signing and form-of TRA

- 2025-05-20: SPAC IPO closes; no TRA contemplated at IPO
- 2025-10-19: 8-K reports Business Combination Agreement with Evernorth / Pathfinder Digital Assets / Ripple Labs; Form of Tax Receivable Agreement attached as Exhibit 10.9 with blank preamble date and unsigned signature blocks

#### Pre-closing periodic filings

- 2026 (Q1 10-Q filed mid-2026): BCA had not closed as of period-end; no executed TRA on file

## Explanation

Armada Acquisition Corp. II signed a Business Combination Agreement on October 19, 2025 with Evernorth Holdings, Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC, and Ripple Labs that contemplates an Up-C structure with Evernorth as PubCo over Pathfinder OpCo. The accompanying Form of Tax Receivable Agreement, filed as Exhibit 10.9 to the announcement 8-K, would obligate Evernorth to pay Ripple Labs and the Ripple Group Subscribers 85% of cash tax savings from basis adjustments on Common Unit exchanges and from imputed-interest deductions. The form is unexecuted (blank preamble date and signature blocks) and the BCA had not closed as of the latest 10-Q in the directory, so the executed TRA has not yet been filed. Status is Unknown pending the closing 8-K and executed contract. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
